en.plugins.dice.usage:
🎲 *Dice and coin*

*Free rolls:*
{0}dice [d6|2d6|d20|coin|NdM] — NdM = N dice with M sides (up to {1}d{2})

*Bets* (groups only, {3} to {4} coins):
• {0}dice d6 <bet> <1-6> — exact number, pays x{5} (1 in 6)
• {0}dice 2d6 <bet> — a double, pays x{6} (1 in 6)
• {0}dice d20 <bet> — a 20, pays x{7} (1 in 20)
• {0}dice coin <bet> <heads|tails> — pays x{8} (1 in 2)

_A win pays the multiplier times your bet, stake included. The house keeps an edge: on average you get back {9}% (d6, 2d6), {10}% (d20) or {11}% (coin) of what you bet._
